question: If 3x - ky + 8 = 0 and 9x - 18y + 20 = 0 have no solution, find k.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a system of linear equations to have no solution, the ratio of x-coefficients must equal the ratio of y-coefficients.

Ratio of x-coefficients = 3 ÷ 9 = 1/3

Ratio of y-coefficients = (−k) ÷ (−18) = k/18

Equating the ratios: k/18 = 1/3 ⇒ k = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Equation 1: 3x − ky + 8 = 0

Equation 2: 9x − 18y + 20 = 0

**Formula Used:**

For two linear equations a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0 and a₂x + b₂y + c₂ = 0 to have no solution:

a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂ ≠ c₁ / c₂

**Calculation:**

⇒ Here, a₁ = 3, b₁ = −k, c₁ = 8

⇒ And, a₂ = 9, b₂ = −18, c₂ = 20

⇒ 3 / 9 = (−k) / (−18) ≠ 8 / 20

⇒ 1 / 3 = k / 18 ≠ 2 / 5

⇒ Since 1 / 3 ≠ 2 / 5 is true, we equate the first two terms:

⇒ k = 18 ÷ 3

⇒ k = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unique Solution (Intersecting Lines)

The system of equations has exactly one solution when the lines intersect at a single point. Condition: a₁ / a₂ ≠ b₁ / b₂.

Infinite Solutions (Coincident Lines)

The system of equations has infinitely many solutions when the lines overlap completely. Condition: a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂ = c₁ / c₂.

No Solution (Parallel Lines)

The system of equations has no solution when the lines are parallel and never intersect. Condition: a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂ ≠ c₁ / c₂.
